confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is least certain. July is green (rainy) season in Luang Prabang, so accommodation anchors reflect below-peak demand, and taxes and fees are assumed included. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA page and was not independently read on the page; the 16 October figure from a third-party site was excluded as unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional SEA basis: priced against tourist-facing Southeast Asian towns such as Chiang Mai and northern Thailand, adjusted down to Lao price levels for restaurants and guesthouses. Beer and cocktail-to-beer relationships are based on local bar and restaurant price patterns, since direct knowledge of Lao cocktail prices is weaker.
